description: This file defines an abstract class GammaBase which provides methods for computing gamma functions, incomplete gamma, and related statistical distribution calculations, likely intended for use in statistical computations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: GammaBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for gamma function calculations, including incomplete gamma and gamma value computation, used for statistical distributions.

methods.name: calculateDistribution
methods.description: Computes either the gamma distribution or its inverse, based on parameters, incorporating cumulative and density calculations.

methods.name: calculateInverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of a gamma distribution's cumulative function using Newton-Raphson and bisection methods.

methods.name: incompleteGamma
methods.description: Calculates the incomplete gamma function using a series expansion.

methods.name: gammaValue
methods.description: Computes the gamma function value for a given input using approximation and reflection formulas.

methods.name: logGamma
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the gamma function for a positive real number, with caching for efficiency.
